title: Codefly dashboard data model
description: The resolved shapes a Codefly dashboard catalog binds to by JSON Pointer. Generated from @codefly-dev/ui's own DashboardView types.

key.description: The group this point is of — a bucket, a label, a name.

value.description: The resolved value for that group.

points.description: The resolved points, in the order they are drawn.

total.description: Null when the series is empty or partial, or not additive across groups — not zero.

coverage.description: Completeness of the observed telemetry, not proof that every producer emitted.

visualization.description: How the widget draws its series.

failure.description: How the read ended when it did not succeed. Not a severity ordering: "failed" says the read did not complete and says nothing about authority, so a series already in hand is still drawn, as stale; "refused" says this viewer may not see the number, which makes a previously fetched one wrong rather than old, so the renderer discards it.

span.description: Grid columns this widget spans; ignored in a stack.

section.description: The id of the section this widget is drawn in. A widget naming no section, or one the view does not declare, falls to the untitled group.

format.description: How a scalar widget's value reads. Defaults to a number.

unit.description: Suffix after a scalar widget's value, e.g. "req/s".

higherIsBetter.description: When false a rising value reads as bad, the way an error count does. Defaults true.

sections.description: The sections the widgets are grouped into, in the order they are drawn. A view without sections draws its widgets as one untitled group.

columns.description: Grid column count; ignored in a stack.

accent.description: Any CSS colour, applied to this dashboard's charts through the primary token.
